versions.name: Mataguay Scout Ranch

features.note: The council bills this as the largest range and target program on the west coast.
An NRA First Steps pistol orientation, offered within the older-Scout programme.
Single-action revolvers, lever-action rifles, and double-barrel shotguns in old-time western scenarios, for participants aged fourteen and over.
An aviation merit-badge programme culminating in a real glider ride with a partner glider port, alongside robotics, engineering, journalism, and photography.
Trails for all levels, with bikes available to borrow.
Part of a trades programme with metalwork, painting, and automotive maintenance.
Lake Dan Henry, used for open boating time.
The Pathfinder Trail to First Class programme, including swim instruction.
Four jams of adventure for Scouts fourteen and over, ending with a choose-your-own activity day.

versions.summary: Mountain Scouts BSA resident summer camp operated by San Diego-Imperial Council, located near Lake Henshaw in Santa Ysabel, California.

sources.citation: coordinate geocoded from street address (US Census / OpenStreetMap), 2026-07-22

provenance.notes: Coordinate refined 2026-07-22 from the camp's street address (was a city/state-centroid approximation). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
